# Carex 3 Wheel Walker for Seniors, Foldable, Rollator Walker with Three Wheels, Three Wheel Rolling Walker Height Adjustable for Seniors, Blue, Trio, Folding
Brand: Carex
Category: Walkers, Rollators & Accessories > Rolling Walkers

## Features
Contains (1) Carex Trio Rolling Walker, three-wheeled rolling walker for seniors. Lightweight, foldable & compact for easy maneuverability in tight spaces. Collapses quickly for storage & transport. Large storage bag & height adjustable handles. 7" wheels with locking brakes, one of the leading walkers in the category.; This lightweight, folding, three-wheeled walker is easy to maneuver for increased mobility in narrow spaces. It goes where you go with its quick-collapse system for easy storage & transport. 3 wheeled rollators are much more maneuverable, but are really not intended for people who need full support or side to side balance issues; The Carex Trio Rolling Walker includes a large storage bag with pockets for ID cards and cell phone. Transport yourself and your accessories with ease as you cruise through your day. It folds neatly and is a great choice for the elderly or handicap.DO NOT use a rollator in mud, ice, or puddles; With height adjustable handles, the Carex Trio Rolling Walker is easy to customize for an ideal comfort level. The 7" wheels with locking brakes mean you get the support you need whether standing still or rolling smoothly along. Quick tool-free assembly; The three wheel rollator features one wheel in the front and two wheels in the back. This adult walker is perfect for senior members of the family who still want their independence.

## Specifications
Product Dimensions: 22 x 25.5 x 38 inches; 10 pounds; Department: Bedroom; Date First Available: February 4, 2011; Age Range Description: Senior; Global Trade Identification Number: 00023601013330, 30023601013331

## Pricing & Reviews
Price: 154.34 USD.
Rated 4.2 from 2716 reviews.

## Details
Model: FGA33300 0000. UPC: 023601313331 023601013330

## Description
Is the Trio Rolling Walker easy to maneuver in narrow spaces? Yes. Its lightweight, three-wheel design makes turning and moving through tight indoor spaces easier than many four-wheel walkers. Does the walker fold for transportation or storage? Yes. The frame collapses quickly into a compact shape for storing in a closet, car trunk, or behind a vehicle seat. Are the handles height adjustable? Yes. The handles adjust from approximately 31.75 to 38 inches. Both handles should always be secured at the same height before use. Does it include storage? Yes. A large storage bag is included, along with dedicated pockets for an ID card and cell phone. Personal items should be carried in the bag rather than hung from the handles. Is this walker designed for someone who needs full-body support? No. It is for users who can balance weight evenly between both handles. It is not intended for heavy leaning support or significant balance issues. Use only on dry, stable surfaces; avoid mud, ice, and puddles.

This allows the user to be mobile and control where they go without having to use a limited square walker with the ugly tennis balls on the feet. This is a solidly built assistive device, with all of the exact same features as much higher priced similar items, so it is budget friendly and a SOLID, attractive product.
